# Travel Hacking Toolkit

> A comprehensive toolkit for searching flights, hotels, and award availability across multiple sources. Combines cash pricing (Ignav, Bilt portal), award search (seats.aero), portal pay-with-points (Amex MR), and transfer partner optimization into unified comparison tools. Designed for use by AI coding assistants and agents (OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex).

Key concepts:
- **Cash prices** come from GDS feeds (Ignav, Bilt portal) and are bookable fares
- **Award prices** come from loyalty program availability (seats.aero) and require transferring credit card points
- **Portal prices** come from the Amex travel portal and let you pay with MR points directly
- **Transfer partners** map credit card points to airline/hotel loyalty programs at various ratios
- **CPP (cents per point)** measures redemption value. Higher CPP = better use of points

Skill listings below are auto-generated from `skills/*/SKILL.md` frontmatter by `scripts/gen-skill-tables.sh`. Do not hand-edit between BEGIN/END markers.

## Orchestration (start here)

<!-- BEGIN: llms:orchestration -->
- [Ams For](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/ams-for/SKILL.md): AMS to Fortaleza family search across every gateway. Cash and awards priced in BRL against cost basis.
- [Award Calendar](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/award-calendar/SKILL.md): Cheapest award dates for a route across a date range. Calendar grid view.
- [Compare Flights](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/compare-flights/SKILL.md): Unified flight comparison across ALL sources in parallel. Auto-applies transfer optimization.
- [Compare Hotels](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/compare-hotels/SKILL.md): Unified hotel comparison across portals, metasearch, and Airbnb. FHR/Edit stacking detection.
- [Gardening](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/gardening/SKILL.md): Audit existing reservations for price drops, better cabins, schedule changes, and improved routings.
- [Getting Started](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/getting-started/SKILL.md): First-run onboarding. Detects setup, points to setup-keys script, shows sample prompts.
- [Plan Trip](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/plan-trip/SKILL.md): Guided trip planner. The hero command for the toolkit.
- [Trip Calculator](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/trip-calculator/SKILL.md): Cash vs points decision answered with math. Transfer ratios, taxes, opportunity cost.
- [Trip Log](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/trip-log/SKILL.md): Opt-in trip journal. Save searches and booked trips to trips/logs/ for future reference.
- [Trip Planner](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/trip-planner/SKILL.md): Full trip planning. Flights + hotels + points in one shot.

## Flights

<!-- BEGIN: llms:flights -->
- [Google Flights](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/google-flights/SKILL.md): Browser-automated Google Flights. All airlines.
- [Ignav](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/ignav/SKILL.md): Fast REST API cash prices. Market selection for arbitrage.
- [Seatmaps](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/seatmaps/SKILL.md): Aircraft seat maps, cabin dimensions, seat recommendations.
- [Seats Aero](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/seats-aero/SKILL.md): Award availability across 27 mileage programs. Partner API, plus the official MCP (keyless for the next 60 days, Pro sign-in for live search and alerts).
- [Wikipedia Airports](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/wikipedia-airports/SKILL.md): Route discovery and airline-service sanity check via Wikipedia airport pages. Answers "does carrier X fly A→B" and "what airports serve destination Y" when fare tools disagree or miss obscure regional service. No API key.

## Loyalty and Points

<!-- BEGIN: llms:loyalty -->
- [Avios](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/avios/SKILL.md): Avios and Iberia Club. Off-peak pricing, Combine Avios, cheapest paths in, Qatar stand-in, MAD-FOR.
- [Azul Fidelidade](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/azul-fidelidade/SKILL.md): Azul Fidelidade awards. Lisbon flights, TAP awards, beneficiary rules. Seats.aero hides seat counts.
- [Bonificadas](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/bonificadas/SKILL.md): Current Brazilian transfer bonuses and point purchase promos. Refreshed from Brazilian points blogs.
- [Brazil Shopping](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/brazil-shopping/SKILL.md): Cashback and points per R$ for any Brazilian online store via Comparemania, valued at your cost basis.
- [Flying Blue](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/flying-blue/SKILL.md): Flying Blue awards. Promo Rewards, dynamic pricing, taxes, holds, child discount, Family pooling, Amex NL 2 to 1.
- [Latam Pass](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/latam-pass/SKILL.md): LATAM Pass awards. Dynamic own-metal pricing, fixed partner table, booking rules. Not on Seats.aero.
- [Latam Tabela Fixa](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/latam-tabela-fixa/SKILL.md): LATAM Pass fixed partner award chart. Official region matrix, calculator, booking by phone or WhatsApp.
- [My Points](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/my-points/SKILL.md): The user own points and miles balances, cost basis, status and travel profile (local files or own web app).
- [Shopping Portals](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/shopping-portals/SKILL.md): Compare shopping portals and cashback (Flying Blue, Avios eStore, Revolut, CashbackXL, Woolsocks) for a purchase in R$.
- [Smiles](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/smiles/SKILL.md): Smiles GOL awards. Air France and KLM partner awards, Seats.aero coverage, price tiers and booking rules.
- [Status Matcher](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/status-matcher/SKILL.md): Live status match opportunities from your current elite statuses, via statusmatcher.com reports.
- [Tap Miles Go](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/tap-miles-go/SKILL.md): TAP Miles and Go awards. Dynamic pricing, Esfera and Livelo ratios, Fortaleza to Lisbon.
- [Transfer Partners](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/transfer-partners/SKILL.md): Cheapest transfer path from credit card points to mileage programs.
- [Wheretocredit](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/wheretocredit/SKILL.md): Mileage earning rates by airline and booking class across 50+ programs.

- [Deutsche Bahn](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/deutsche-bahn/SKILL.md): Deutsche Bahn (DB) train search across Germany and into AT/CH/NL/FR/BE via the open-source db-vendo-client. Stations, journeys, departure boards. No API key. Pairs with scandinavia-transit for Europe-wide rail coverage.

## Reference and Operations (auto-load on demand)

These skills carry institutional knowledge that the agent loads when triggered. They cover the workflow rules, reference tables, failure recovery, and lessons learned that prevent the most common mistakes.

<!-- BEGIN: llms:reference -->
- [Alliances](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/alliances/SKILL.md): Star Alliance, oneworld, SkyTeam membership and recent shifts (SAS to SkyTeam, ITA to Star, Hawaiian/Fiji to oneworld). Key cross-alliance booking relationships.
- [Award Holds](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/award-holds/SKILL.md): Per-program rules for placing award flight tickets on hold. Covers 9 programs with holds (AA 24h online, LH 5 days, FB 3 days, CX 2 days, Turkish 2 days, Virgin Atlantic 1-2 days, ANA 2 days, Emirates 1 day, EVA online), Singapore as agent-discretionary, and the negative space (UA/AS/DL/Aeroplan/BA/Qatar/Korean/Etihad - many programs still do not allow holds).
- [Award Sweet Spots](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/award-sweet-spots/SKILL.md): Catalog of legendary, excellent, and good award redemptions with current rates and devaluation history.
- [Booking Guidance](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/booking-guidance/SKILL.md): The booking flow, hold-before-transfer rule, phone numbers for major programs.
- [Brazil Programs](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/brazil-programs/SKILL.md): Livelo, Esfera, Smiles, LATAM Pass and Azul. Cost basis in R$ per milheiro and when each program wins.
- [Cabin Codes](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/cabin-codes/SKILL.md): IATA cabin codes (F/J/W/Y) and saver fare class codes (X/I/O) for partner-bookable inventory.
- [Fallback And Resilience](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/fallback-and-resilience/SKILL.md): What to do when each tool fails. Tool-by-tool fallback paths.
- [Flight Search Strategy](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/flight-search-strategy/SKILL.md): The canonical multi-source search workflow. Source priority (Ignav > Bilt portal > Google Flights > others), market selection for international routes, source accuracy hierarchy, common failure modes.
- [Hotel Chains](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/hotel-chains/SKILL.md): Maps brand names (Westin, Holiday Inn, etc.) to chain families and loyalty programs.
- [Lessons Learned](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/lessons-learned/SKILL.md): Hard-won knowledge from real searches. The mandatory Seats.aero workflow, source accuracy, small-market caveats, Ignav limitations. Load before any award flight search.
- [Partner Awards](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/partner-awards/SKILL.md): Which programs ticket which airlines (alliance + bilateral). Cross-references credit card currencies to booking programs. Reachability workflow.
- [Points Valuations](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/points-valuations/SKILL.md): CPP formula, floor/ceiling rules, surcharge-heavy programs to avoid, transfer bonus considerations, Chase Points Boost dynamics, opportunity cost.
- [Round The World](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/round-the-world/SKILL.md): RTW + Pacific Circle + Asia-Pacific Circle + regional distance-award reference. 13 active programs, 4 discontinued.
- [Status Match](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/status-match/SKILL.md): Per-program status match rules with lifetime / once-per-N-years warnings, free vs paid concierge distinction, real fees, plus card-granted renewable status as the alternative.
- [Stopovers](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/stopovers/SKILL.md): Per-program stopover rules for award redemptions. Includes Icelandair free stopover, Aeroplan, Alaska Atmos, Flying Blue, Singapore tiers, plus the negative space (BA, AA, Delta, JetBlue) that have no stopover programs.
- [Transfer Bonuses](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/skills/transfer-bonuses/SKILL.md): Active credit card transfer bonuses with primary-source citations. Tells the agent the real effective ratio when transferring points during a promotion.
<!-- END: llms:reference -->

## Docker Images

All images are public on GitHub Container Registry. Pull with `docker pull ghcr.io/borski/<name>:latest`.

- `ghcr.io/borski/patchright-docker`: Base image. Patchright + Chromium + xvfb. All other browser-skill images build on this.

## Data Files

Local JSON data referenced by skills. No API keys required.

- [Transfer Partners](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/data/transfer-partners.json): Credit card to loyalty program transfer ratios from 6 issuers.
- [Points Valuations](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/data/points-valuations.json): CPP floor/ceiling per program from 4 sources (TPG, Upgraded Points, OMAAT, VFTW).
- [Alliances](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/data/alliances.json): Star Alliance, oneworld, SkyTeam membership and key booking relationships.
- [Partner Awards](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/data/partner-awards.json): Which programs ticket which airlines, including cross-alliance bilateral partnerships.
- [Sweet Spots](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/data/sweet-spots.json): Legendary, excellent, and good award redemptions plus airline release windows.
- [Hotel Chains](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/data/hotel-chains.json): Brand to loyalty program mapping with quick-lookup index.
- [FHR Properties](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/data/fhr-properties.json): Amex Fine Hotels & Resorts property database with coordinates and benefits.
- [THC Properties](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/data/thc-properties.json): Amex The Hotel Collection property database.
- [Chase Edit Properties](https://github.com/borski/travel-hacking-toolkit/blob/main/data/chase-edit-properties.json): Chase Sapphire Reserve Hotel Collection properties.
